text: The girls and the Dolomites are wearing Arc'teryx jackets and North Face fleeces. They're either in bike shorts with white crew socks, or they are wearing parachute cargo pants. You can get them from Jaded London. I think they have a really trendy one like these. They're in neutral earth tones, and they're adding a pop of color from their beanies that they got at the hiking shop. They're wearing wraparound sunglasses with a silver frame. It's very Y2K vibes, usually Oakley. And they're wearing a headband or a cap, sometimes a bandana. They look gorgeous all the time.
